name: Rinkan ~Kizumono no Imouto~
source:
Tachibana Tsubame is a girl who has a crush on the student council president, Amakusa Tokitsugu, but her dreams of dating him are shattered when he decides to date her twin sister Sayuki instead. To add insult to injury, Sayuki is also made the vice chairwoman of the student council after dating Tokitsugu. The enraged Tsubame tries to get revenge on her sister by hatching a plot that will cause her male classmates to rape her, but she soon loses control of her plans.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/235001/]MobyGames[/url]]
